get.description: Checks server liveness and database connectivity. Not versioned, not authenticated.

post.description: Any logged-in user, no permission needed. Multipart form: description (1 to 2000 characters), pageUrl and userAgent (1 to 500 characters each), and an optional screenshot file (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB max). The screenshot is re-encoded into a WebP thumb and display pair under /uploads/bug-reports, the same way as item photos. 400 for missing or too long text, a wrong type or an oversized screenshot.
